programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Space Shuttle Documentary"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli speaks with five astronauts who ventured into space aboard this amazing and complex spacecraft.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "What Makes a Planet?"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at many objects that, regardless of definition, look like new and fascinating planets.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "A Space Station for All"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores what kind of experiments are being conducted on the International Space Station that will benefit humans on earth.

programs.title: The New Frontier S2 - "First Light"
programs.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther – carrying us ever closer to the first light.

programs.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Stars Above"
programs.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes… and, let’s face it, they can be dim or bright. Recent discoveries suggest the number of stars in our galaxy alone may exceed 200 billion.

programs.title: The New Frontier S2 - "The Dark Side"
programs.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe.
